data_fields.name: stride_walk_run_back_strafe
data_fields.donor_constant: monnifs Stride column per model (value not read)

best_idea: Drive a locomotion clip's cycle from ground speed divided by the stride length (with a per-clip playback rate for standing), and keep the authored key timeline separate from the played rate as data.
decision_why: The stride match stops feet skating and the authored/played split is cheap data; we take the shape but make phase a cycle fraction and make the hold and blend lengths explicit, because the donor's phase offset is not a clean cycle fraction and its hold flag is not applied on the render path.
acceptance: A walking hero or creature at speed S with a stride of L completes one walk cycle every L/S seconds, so a server-free client test asserts the cycle fraction equals (elapsed * S / L) mod 1 within 1e-3, and a 30-frame idle authored at 15 fps and played at 4 fps takes 7.5 s per cycle.
